mastery_requirements.INTRODUCED: Problem seen; exposure alone is not competence.
mastery_requirements.UNDERSTOOD: An independently reviewed causal explanation or deterministic reasoning check for this exact concept.
mastery_requirements.APPLIED: Correct unassisted executable or independently reviewed solution.
mastery_requirements.DEBUGGED: Correct unassisted repair of a different broken task, with reviewed causal diagnosis.
mastery_requirements.TRANSFERRED: Correct unassisted task in a different business domain, at least one day after earlier application.
mastery_requirements.MASTERED: All preceding evidence, at least three distinct tasks, at least two business domains, and two unassisted successful recall checks on distinct days, spanning at least seven days.

difficulty.dimension_scale: 0 absent, 1 bounded, 2 substantial, 3 material ambiguity or consequence; level is authored, not a code-length score.

INCIDENT.opening: symptoms and evidence; root cause withheld

REVIEW.opening: Pull request and consumer contract; diagnose before repairing.

PERFORMANCE.opening: Consumer contract, declared scale and actual fixture plan.

no_suitable_problem: Report the coverage gap; never generate or claim an unavailable problem.
authority: AE-owned local learning evidence; Toptal examination and canonical mastery remain separate.
